exposure: knowledge of HIV transmission routes (sexual, MTCT, breastfeeding risk)
knowledge of HIV preventive methods (condom use, ART during pregnancy, elective C-section)
outcome: level of knowledge regarding HIV transmission and prevention
level of preventive practices regarding HIV
cohort: The study included 500 antenatal women attending a tertiary care center in Meerut, India.
finding: Antenatal women demonstrated good awareness of general HIV transmission routes and condom use, but significant knowledge gaps persisted regarding mother-to-child transmission, breastfeeding risks, antiretroviral therapy during pregnancy, and elective C-section as preventive measures.
mod_finding: Awareness regarding elective C-section as a preventive method for mother-to-child HIV transmission was suboptimal (29.0%).
